The largest man-made lake in the world

Lake Kariba stretches about 220 km. Elephants drink at the shore, hippos surface at dusk, and the sun sets over open water.

Fishing

Tigerfish and bream. Ask us about guides and half-day trips.

Houseboats and cruises

Sunset cruises and multi-day houseboat trips leave from Kariba.

Wildlife

Look for elephant, hippo and crocodile along the shoreline.
